title: VALLIS-3C
description: Scenario- and site-conditioned stochastic simulation of three-component ground motions at sites in the Basin of Mexico. The software release includes the fitted models and processed research artifacts required to run and audit VALLIS-3C; original RAII-UNAM and RACM/CIRES ground-motion recordings are not included.
